name: "SMC-CFG" stateless sign bias (belgiangurista)
plain: Labelled SMC but has no memory or sliding surface. It adds a fixed-size sign term based on current guidance to the noise-space result. The code comments admit it is an approximation.
math:
e = c − u; f = u + s·e − k·sign(e)
smc_cfg_lambda and no_cfg_warmup_steps are accepted but unused.
Since c,u are x−x̂: x̂ = x̂_cfg + k·sign(x̂_u − x̂_c), i.e. a constant-size per-element nudge.
label: from code
surprise: Lambda and warm-up widgets do nothing; correction is independent of s and of step history.
